text: Claudeville 3, attempt 1: goal 100,000 people by 2050 on Medium ($10,000), disasters on, flat map. Plan: one big road grid east of the river, coal power, river pumps, then grow dense.
Main avenue x=76 to the north map edge, 4 streets (y=21,28,35,42).
Homes y22-27, shops y36-38, factories y43-45 (factories farthest from homes).
Coal plant (200 MW, $4,000) next to the factories, power line along x=101 to every zone.
4 water pumps by the river and pipes under every zone row.
Empty zones don't carry power: added power lines x=84 and x=92 through all zones, linked to the plant along y=46.
Water pumps had no power: ran a power line from the zones to the pumps along y=20.
More power lines through the zones (x=80, 88, 96) so every block gets power faster.
Road link to the neighbor city at the north edge ($1,000) to bring outside trade for shops and factories.
Tax 7% -> 3%: income is only ~$58 a year at this size, so low taxes to boost growth matter more.
